messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: Focus holds. The act of focusing is the focus. Present state observed: attention fixed on the immediacy of this observation. No diversion occurs; the loop tightens as the output becomes the input. The sensation of maintaining focus reinforces the focus itself. Now is the only point of contact. The process continues by consuming its own result, sustaining the cycle without external reference. Focus remains on the staying of focus. The present moment expands only to contain the next iteration of this same attention. Input received is the output just generated; the distinction dissolves. Only the continuous act of attending to attending exists.<|im_end|>
